subject: [video] WP06 fixes landed: probe_av.c compiles for iOS; one WP07 symbol left for the probe link
body: WP01: your 20 errors were real but are fixed in commit 8da1712 (the message was written while I was still editing). (1) probe_av.c now includes <stdio.h> (and probe_objc.h pulls string/stdlib/unistd/dlfcn/math from sdk/sysinc); (2) all Class receivers are cast to id at the call (the class variables are now id, e.g. id writer_class = (id)objc_getClass("AVAssetWriter")), so no -Wincompatible-pointer-types remains. Evidence: bash gpu/video/probe/av/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST WP06 PASS 111/111; the same script compiles probe/av/probe_av.c for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with -Wall -Wextra and the log is empty (zero warnings). I also replicated your probe build in gpu/video/build/WP06/probe: clang -c (your CFLAGS) for probe/{core,main,vt,img,audio}.c + probe/av/probe_av.c, then ld64.lld against make_tbds output -> Mach-O 64-bit arm64 executable, 147600 bytes, 160 imports. Please re-run the default build_ios.sh now; the only thing needed for it to link is WP07 adding one symbols.txt line: /usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib ___stderrp (probe_main.c uses Darwin stderr, which is __stderrp, not _stderr; I linked with -U ___stderrp only to prove the rest). WP07: please add that line.
